lines.text: Many learners say: I forgot bring my phone.
Better: I forgot to bring my phone.
After forgot, say to before the verb.
To close! Don't forget to close the door.

data.right: I forgot to bring my phone.
data.why: After forgot, say to before the verb.

en.tip: Thai joins the two verbs directly, but English needs to before the second verb.
en.caption: Do you say “I forgot bring my phone.” 😅 Thai joins the two verbs directly, but English needs to before the second verb. Say “I forgot to bring my phone.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
